name: openpixo/cozy-pastel
title: Cozy pastel
description: Calm domestic spaces and gentle objects in warm, low-contrast pastel colors.

description_i18n.en: Calm domestic spaces and gentle objects in warm, low-contrast pastel colors.
description_i18n.zh-CN: 以温暖、低对比的粉彩色调，表现安静的日常空间和柔和物件。

examples.title: Tea room corner
examples.prompt: Generate a cozy tea room corner using the cozy-pastel art style, with a low wooden table, two cushions, a teapot and a sunlit plant. Keep the layout uncluttered and the mood calm.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 cozy-pastel 美术风格生成温馨茶室一角：低木桌、两个坐垫、茶壶和阳光下的植物。布局保持简洁，氛围平静。

examples.title: Garden tool icons
examples.prompt: Create a matching garden tool icon set using the cozy-pastel art style: watering can, hand rake, seed tin and clay pot. Use matte surfaces and soft sage-and-rose accents.

prompt_i18n.zh-CN: 使用 cozy-pastel 美术风格制作配套园艺工具图标：浇水壶、手耙、种子铁盒和陶盆。使用哑光材质与柔和的鼠尾草绿、灰玫瑰粉点色。

style.prompt: Cozy game illustration in a warm pastel palette with rounded simplified forms, matte surfaces and softly textured fills. Gentle diffuse daylight, low-contrast shadows and generous calm negative space. Use cream as a grounding color with sage, dusty rose and pale blue accents. Make objects tactile and welcoming while preserving clear silhouettes.
style.negativePrompt: harsh contrast, deep black shadows, neon colors, glossy chrome, photorealism, busy microtexture, dramatic spotlights, sharp threatening shapes, text, watermark

constraints.outline: Subtle colored contours or edge-defined shapes; no heavy black outline.
